item.title: Galway artist launches exhibition in aid of Hospice at the age of 88
item.description: An inspirational Galway woman – still painting beautifully in her late eighties – will launch an exhibition of her work this Saturday, as a tribute to her sister and her old friend, who have both died from cancer. item.description: Galway Cathedral this week announced the schedule for its annual Novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Help, which will take place from February 2 to 10. item.title: Galway volunteers head to Ethiopia for latest phase of orphanage refurbishment
